display_name.description: The display name of the custom module. This becomes the finding category for all findings returned by this module.
display_name.rationale: The display name is informational and helps analysts identify findings but does not affect security.

enablement_state.description: The enablement state of the custom module. Possible values: ENABLED or DISABLED.
enablement_state.rationale: If disabled, the module does not generate findings, leading to blind spots in monitoring.

custom_config.description: Custom configuration for the module, defining predicate logic, resource scope, severity, and recommendations.
custom_config.rationale: The configuration defines how findings are generated. Weak or missing configs may reduce visibility of important issues.

predicate.description: CEL expression that evaluates resources and generates findings when true.
predicate.rationale: Predicate logic defines detection conditions. Without it, no findings will be generated.

resource_selector.description: The resource types this custom module applies to. Can include up to 5 resource types.
resource_selector.rationale: Restricting modules to relevant resources ensures accurate findings. Empty or incorrect selectors may result in gaps.

severity.description: The severity assigned to findings generated by the module. Valid values: CRITICAL, HIGH, MEDIUM, LOW.
severity.rationale: Severity impacts prioritization in security workflows. Incorrect levels may delay critical remediation.

recommendation.description: Remediation guidance provided for each finding to assist security teams in resolving issues.
recommendation.rationale: Without clear recommendations, security teams may be unable to remediate findings effectively.

project.description: The project where the custom module is defined. If omitted, the provider project is used.
project.rationale: Defines scope but does not directly impact security posture.
